meanings.usage: 表示从一地到另一地的移动

phrases.usage: 被邀请参加（某个活动或聚会）

examples.en: Sally was invited to a children's party.
examples.zh: 莎莉被邀请去参加一个儿童派对。

examples.en: I decided to take her by train.
She sat near the window and asked questions.
examples.zh: 她坐在窗边问了很多问题。

examples.en: A middle-aged lady got on the train.
examples.zh: 一位中年女士上了火车。

examples.en: The lady took out her powder compact.
examples.zh: 那位女士拿出了她的粉盒。

examples.en: She began to make up her face.
She asked questions about everything she saw.
examples.zh: 她问关于她看到的一切的问题。

phrases.usage: /ˈpaʊdə ˈkɒmpækt/ 名词. 粉盒，化妆盒（妇女随身携带的化妆工具）

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻或时间段正在进行的动作 用于描述过去正在发生的事情，常与when/while连用

examples.en: Sally was sitting near the window when a lady got on.
examples.zh: 当一位女士上车时，莎莉正坐在窗边。

examples.en: The lady was dressed in a blue coat.
examples.zh: 那位女士穿着一件蓝色外套。

grammar.title: 特殊疑问句 - Why 引导的原因疑问句
grammar.structure: Why + be动词/助动词 + 主语 + ...?
grammar.definition: 用Why提问原因或理由 询问某人做某事的原因

grammar.title: but连接的转折句
grammar.definition: 用but连接两个意思相反的句子 表示前后意思的转折对比

examples.en: Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
examples.zh: 莎莉觉得好笑，但我却非常尴尬！

patterns.pattern: Why + be动词/助动词 + 主语 + 动词-ing?
主语 + have/has + never + 过去分词

original.en: She had never travelled on a train before.

imitations.en: I have never been to Beijing.
He has never flown a plane.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be动词 + 形容词, but + 主语 + be动词 + 形容词

original.en: Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
original.zh: 莎莉觉得好笑，但我却非常尴尬！

imitations.en: He was happy, but she was sad.
The book was interesting, but the movie was boring.
imitations.zh: 这本书很有趣，但电影很无聊。

lines.en: Last week, my four year old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children’s party. I decided to take her by train. Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before. She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw. Suddenly, a middle-aged lady got on the train and sat opposite Sally.
“Hello, little girl.” She said. Sally did not answer, but looked at her curiously
“Why are you doing that?” Sally asked.
“To make myself beautiful,” the lady answered. She put away her compact and smiled kindly
“But you are still ugly.” Sally said. Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
Sally is four years old.

translation: 上周，我4岁的女儿萨莉被邀请去参加一个儿童聚会。我决定带她乘火车去。萨莉非常激动，因为她从未乘过火车。她靠车窗坐着，对她所看到的一切都要问个明白。突然，一个中年妇女上了火车，坐在萨莉的对面。“你好，小姑娘，”她说。萨莉没回答，却好奇地看着她。那位妇女穿着一件蓝色的大衣，戴着一顶大而滑稽的帽子。火车开出车站后，那位妇女打开了手提包，拿出了粉盒。然后她开始打扮起来。“你为什么要那样做呢？”萨莉问。“为了把自己打扮漂亮啊，”那位妇女答道。她放好了粉盒，慈祥地微笑着。“可是你仍然难看呀，”萨莉说。萨莉感到很有趣，而我却很尴尬。
